messages:
sophia: Heads up — we just saw a sustained p99 spike on /v1/generate starting ~10:12 UTC, correlates with KV cache miss rate jumping ~6x in the heatmap :eyes:

dustin: pinging ops for visibility. any customer impact reported yet?

aria: Not seeing errors, but some latency-sensitive customers reported UI hitches. heatmap looks like a handful of prefixes are very hot and then drop off rapidly.

kevin: Can you paste the heatmap link and sample logs?

sophia: https://internal.redwood/heatmaps/2026-03-15-10-12 -> main cluster, see big vertical stripes on prefix hash buckets 42/87/190. logs: `KV_GET miss=1 key=prefix::session:abc123` repeated, TTLs expiring tiny (5s).

aria: Sounds like prefix fragmentation + noisy headers creating high cardinality keys. Any recent deploys to header normalization or SDK changes?

kevin: We rolled in the client change that appends `X-Trace-Id` to the key for debugging. That will blow up cardinality if not normalized.

julian: Yep — that header is unique per request. evictions + warmup cost explain p95/p99 regressions. Immediate mitigation: revert keying change or strip trace header from cache key.

ops-bot: action created: #INC-4321 (investigate cache key entropy) assigned to kevin + aria — priority P1.

dustin: Quick mitigation plan: 1) add server-side key normalization (strip X-Trace-Id) gate behind config; 2) increase warmup-drip to 50qps for affected shards; 3) temporarily increase cache size by 20% on hot hosts; 4) enable circuit-breaker to fallback to smaller model for <1s SLA-sensitive routes. Thoughts? :thumbsup:

kevin: +1 on normalization gate. I can push a hotfix to strip headers in the cache key generator by EOD. I also recommend moving eviction policy from LRU to TTL-based for these prefixes for 24h to reduce churn.

aria: For warmup, we should stagger to avoid cold pressure — start at 10qps and ramp to 50qps per shard over 3 minutes. I can run the heat-probe job.

sophia: Repro steps I used that show the blowup locally:
```
# simulate noisy SDK churn
for i in $(seq 1 500); do 
  TRACE=$(uuidgen)
  curl -s -H "X-Trace-Id: $TRACE" -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":16}' &
done
```
This produces a flood of unique keys and `KV_GET miss` spam in logs.

julian: Nice repro. Also found a race in prefix canonicalization where header order affects key hash — will make canonical sort of header list.

kevin: Owner tasks: kevin -> hotfix key strip + canonicalize header order; aria -> run staggered warmup probers + monitor miss ratio; sophia -> notify support/CS on status and list mitigation steps; julian -> patch canonicalization race.

dustin: I'll schedule an ops rolling restart for the 3 most affected nodes if miss ratio doesn't drop in 15m.

ops-bot: update: #INC-4321 status="in_progress" watchers=[sophia,dustin,aria,kevin,julian].

aria: Initial metrics after hotfix rollout (5m): miss rate down ~72%, p99 trending down from 1.9s -> 650ms. Still monitoring for secondary hotspots.

sophia: Support note drafted, will send to customers on impacted routes. Thanks team. :clap:
